codeReview.summary: The feature satisfies VAL-CRIT-002. The sidepanel stores the ResizeObserver reference, disconnects it in a dedicated destroy() cleanup method, nulls the reference, and invokes that cleanup from both pagehide and beforeunload so the observer is released when the sidepanel closes or unloads.

summary: Pass. The reviewed commit disconnects the sidepanel ResizeObserver during teardown and triggers that teardown on both pagehide and beforeunload, satisfying the expected behavior for fix-resize-observer-leak / VAL-CRIT-002. No blocking or non-blocking code issues were identified in the reviewed implementation.
